messages:
jamie: quick q — should the rerank API surface bounded scores (0-1) or keep raw logits? product wants stable dashboard buckets and simpler alerts.
anika: my vote is bounded for console/UX. easier to aggregate. but we should keep raw around for provenance/diagnostics.
leo: from product side — buckets (0-0.2 / 0.2-0.6 / 0.6-1) make SLA & drift alerts way simpler. also helps A/B comparisons.
jamie: key tradeoffs: softmax per-candidate-list makes scores non-comparable across requests (depends on candidate set). raw keeps monotonicity per-model.
ria: for telemetry and anomaly detection we prefer a globally-calibrated score. can we export both? score_raw + score_norm. storage overhead small.
anika: yeah we can add optional fields: score_raw, score_norm, plus score_meta with method/model. example:
```
{
  "candidate_id": "c123",
  "score_raw": -2.3,
  "score_norm": 0.72
}
```
leo: 👍 but question on billing: we currently count candidate units. if norm changes anything? devs might expect normalized units.
jamie: keep billing=1 candidate per entry. normalization is purely a surface/telemetry thing. no change to quota math.
anika: implementation detail: normalization options: softmax across candidates (sum=1) vs sigmoid per-candidate (independent). softmax preserves relative weights but can be misleading; sigmoid gives per-candidate calibrated score.
jamie: softmax is intuitive for ranking but sum=1 could mislead people into thinking it's a probability across the corpus. docs need to be explicit.
leo: proposal: default to softmax-normalized field called score_norm, keep score_raw, and add tooltip in console explaining semantics and caveats.
ria: telemetry needs these tags: normalization_method, model_id, model_version, candidate_count, sample_hash. also surface if score_norm was computed server-side or client-side.
jamie: action items:
- anika: add optional fields + feature flag (server-side softmax default) and emit normalization_method in telemetry
- leo: update console mockups to show score_norm by default and add tooltip/caveat copy
- ria: extend telemetry schema with fields above and add sampling for full raw dumps for regression
- jamie: draft API docs and rollout playbook
any objections?
anika: no objections. i'll open a PR with ff and an example of the JSON shape.
deploy-bot: feature-flag created: ff/rerank-score-norm. owners: @anika. rollout: canary 10% -> 100%.
jamie: perfect — i'll add to the rollout checklist and update the quota dashboard to make it clear we still bill per candidate unit. :thumbsup:
leo: thanks all, will sync with ux next week for the tooltip copy.
ria: i'll add telemetry validations to the pipeline once the PR lands.
jamie: cool. small follow-up: for tie-breaking we should keep score_raw precision in logs. don't quantize on output.
anika: noted. will keep full float in score_raw and let console round for display.
leo: sounds good — thanks everyone.
jamie: closing this thread — will post RFC link when docs are up.
